notes.title: 🛠️ Third Patch! 🚀 BIG UPDATE 🚀 🎧 NEW MUSIC🎧 🏆ACHIEVEMENTS🏆
notes.content:
⚔️ Gameplay & Balance Changes

🏯 Yasuke can no longer desecrate Japanese shrines.

💪 KeiMan’s HP increased—he’s tougher than ever.

💥 KeiMan now has explosion sound effects for extra impact.

🎭 KeiMan level reworked—smaller boss arena with added obstacles.

🏍️ Motorcycle now moves faster in reverse for better handling.

🔊 Added new voice lines 

🚗 You can now destroy Japanese objects driving vehicles.

🎨 Visual & Audio Enhancements

🏔️ Chapter 5 mountains restored—they were accidentally disabled!

🌌 New skyboxes added across the chapters more immersive atmosphere.

🚆 Fixed bullet train material on low graphics settings.

🎶 2 new background music tracks added!

🚗 Experimental screen-space reflections added to the car level.

📝 Quality of Life & Fixes
✅ Fixed continue option—no more getting stuck!

🏯 Lighting Reworked across Levels

🚪 Cars can now drive through doors—because why not?

🔑 more Secrets added.

🎤 Tutorial updated with dialogue reminding players to destroy objects.

🎵 Car song 3 outro fixed—no more creepy horror track!

🚶 Footstep sounds added to all chapters for more immersion.

🛠️ Auto-walk issue with virtual controller inputs should be fixed.

🏆 30 achievements added—more coming soon!

🎛️ Game now saves quality settings from the main menu (default Ultra).

⚡ More to Come!
We’re constantly improving the game—thanks for playing Yasuke Simulator and keep slicing through history! 🎌🔥

notes.title: Yasuke Simulator - Second Patch Update! 🚀

More tweaks and improvements are on the way—thanks for playing Yasuke Simulator and keep slicing through history! 🎌🔥

notes.title: Enjoy the first Patch
notes.content:
🎉 Yasuke Simulator - First Patch Notes! 🚀
Hey warriors! Our first patch is here, packed with bug fixes, optimizations, and a little extra polish to keep your samurai experience as accurate as possible.

-Performance & Fixes
-The truck level got a HUGE FPS boost! No more slideshow action!
-KeiMan now actually attacks Yasuke.
-Yasuke can’t kill cinematic NPCs anymore. 
-Boss music now loops properly. No more awkward silence mid-battle!
-Fixed that weird pause/freeze when loading into the night level. Now it’s smooth as a katana slash.
-Multiple dialogue issues resolved. 
-Speech bubbles now behave properly in non-standard resolutions (SteamDeck)
-Credits now display properly in both the menu and the end screen.
-Daruma dolls dont fall through the floor anymore.

🗺️ Major Level Overhaul!
The final chapter got a BIG layout redesign due to enemy pathfinding issues. No more confused enemies wandering in circles! 🏯👹

🎨 Graphical Touch-Ups
Some sneaky historical accuracy improvements have made their way into the game—because keeping things authentic is always the priority. 


⚡ More Improvements Coming Soon!
Second Patch should follow soon.

Thank you for Playing Yasuke Simulator
